files.role: Pure, Android-free, sample-accurate beat generator used by the click audio thread. Fractional accumulation: the interval to the next beat is computed when the previous beat is emitted from the CURRENT target (frames = sampleRate*60/spm, fractional remainder carried), never from timers. Target 0 = silence (no beat, accumulator reset so the first beat after silence starts immediately).

public_objects.value: object: SAMPLE_RATE_HZ=44100, CLICK_MS=12, CLICK_FREQ_HZ=1800, CLICK_PEAK=0.5 (fraction of full scale at volume 1.0), BUFFER_MS=20, DEFAULT_VOLUME=0.2 (0..1, MetronomeConfig default)

methods.name: fill
methods.purpose: Writes `frames` PCM16 mono samples (click overlaid where a beat starts, silence elsewhere) and returns the number of beats that STARTED inside this buffer. Deterministic: N frames at S spm yield floor-consistent beat positions with error < 1 frame cumulative.

methods.name: renderClick
methods.purpose: Companion: short sine burst with exponential decay (no DC step, no click-pop).

Start paths (startFree / startPrepared / startRace buttons, lines ~223-244 and RaceCard callback) first run the existing LOCATION permission step, then an OPTIONAL ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION request on first use only (run starts whatever the answer); a DENIED/BLOCKED status shows the one-line note 'Cadence is not recorded (activity permission denied)' on the home panel, no re-prompt without an explicit tap. Home panel also gets the default click volume and manual cadence settings (RunSettings).
